name: manor-snowy
description: Noble's Manor, the snowy look (ROADMAP 49.10f): the shipped H as the White Hall, pale calcite under one steep slate roof whose three pointed gables carry snow, a slate needle spire on the porch tower, a walled winter garden (II), the ballroom wing (III) and the cellar (IV).
